# Only Superfoods

> Hyper-local indoor farm & packhouse in Kadugodi, Whitefield, Bengaluru delivering fresh oyster mushrooms, living microgreens, 21-day raw kombucha, and free-range desi eggs within hours of dawn harvest.

## Farm & Delivery Operations
- **Location:** Kadugodi, Whitefield, Bangalore, Karnataka 560067, India (12.9982° N, 77.7609° E)
- **Website:** https://onlysuperfoods.in
- **WhatsApp Direct Order & Support:** +91 70197 60360 (https://wa.me/917019760360)
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/the_paradise_mushrooms
- **Harvest Schedule:** Hand-harvested daily at 5:30 AM dawn; 0 hours cold storage
- **Delivery Window:** Strict Morning Dawn Drop (7:00 AM – 10:00 AM daily)
- **Order Cutoff:** Orders placed before 11:59 PM are harvested at 5:30 AM and delivered the next morning
- **Service Area (East Bengaluru):** Whitefield, Kadugodi, Hoodi, ITPL, Brookefield, Kundalahalli, Varthur, Balagere, Seegehalli, Belthur, Channasandra, Nagondanahalli, AECS Layout, Marathahalli, Mahadevapura, KR Puram, TC Palya, Ramamurthy Nagar, and Hoskote (plus a 2 km extended buffer zone)
- **Payment Options:** UPI / GPay / PhonePe / Cards via Razorpay (zero fee) or Pay on Delivery (+₹10 convenience fee)
- **Freshness Guarantee:** 100% chemical and pesticide-free; free replacement or instant refund if notified within 2 hours of delivery

## Product Catalog
- [Grey Oyster Mushrooms](https://onlysuperfoods.in/products/grey-oyster-mushrooms): Tender, meaty gourmet oyster clusters (250 g, 500 g, 1 kg packs) harvested at 5:30 AM dawn.
- [Pink Oyster Mushrooms](https://onlysuperfoods.in/products/pink-oyster-mushrooms): Coral-pink Pleurotus djamor gourmet clusters (250 g, 500 g packs).
- [Mixed Oyster Mushrooms](https://onlysuperfoods.in/products/mixed-oyster-mushrooms): Chef's medley of grey, pink, and golden oyster clusters (250 g, 500 g packs).
- [Sunflower Microgreens](https://onlysuperfoods.in/products/sunflower-microgreens): Crunchy living sunflower & radish microgreens (50 g, 100 g packs) with 40x nutrient density.
- [Artisanal Raw Kombucha](https://onlysuperfoods.in/products/kombucha-original): Unpasteurized 21-day fermented probiotic tea elixir (250 ml, 500 ml glass bottles).
- [Free-Range Desi Eggs](https://onlysuperfoods.in/products/desi-eggs): Deep amber yolk country eggs from pasture-roaming hens (6 pcs, 12 pcs, 30 pcs trays).
